# 2.5 多层膜的和频过程（SFG）：要点

> 原作：广濑千秋（沿用项目作者归属；独立底本首页未列署名）  
> 中文翻译：章力
>
> **译校状态（2026-10-20）：** B134—B145完成独立底本全部20页的本轮译校与可编辑数学排版：90个唯一编号式、全部无编号关系及附录D六条证明链齐备。原文疑点保留并加注；E-2.5-001为暂定文字补读。
>
> **底本：** `日语原版/Chapter2/chap2-5.pdf`，20页。按独立底本原顺序和编号推进，不据2.2—2.4的完成状态认定本节已核。

> **阅读导引（译者编写）：** 引言区分五类源点，准备工作建立界面与方向约定。正文随后依次列出激发场、和频极化、L系数、反射与透射场及净场，附录A整理线性光学，附录D证明极化薄片的L系数；本轮均已逐项核验。

## 1. 引言

对于存在和频活性薄膜的体系，本文分别建立分析下列五类和频光信号强度行为所需的表达式：（a）在薄膜与介质1的界面上、介质一侧产生的和频光；（b）在同一界面的膜一侧产生的和频光；（c）在薄膜与介质2的界面上、介质一侧产生的和频光；（d）在同一界面的膜一侧产生的和频光；（e）在膜内部产生的和频光。具体而言，将膜厚纳入所观测的和频电场表达式，使两束激发光与和频光各自的干涉效应得以明确呈现。

## 2. 准备工作

介质 1（入射侧）与介质 2 之间夹有一层厚度为 $h_m$ 的薄膜 (m)，两个界面均为平面且相互平行。坐标轴等定义如下：

- 原点：取为入射点（若有展宽则取其中心）。
- $z$ 轴：从介质 1 指向介质 2 的法线。
- $x$ 轴：取在界面上光的传播方向（沿波矢 $k$ 在界面上的投影方向）。

术语定义如下：

- 1/m 界面：介质 1 与薄膜之间的界面。
- m/2 界面：介质 1 与薄膜之间的界面。（底本原称；见下方疑点说明）
- $n_1, n_2, n_m$：介质 1、介质 2、薄膜 m 的折射率。
- $k_1, k_2, k_m$：介质 1、介质 2、薄膜 m 中的波矢。
- $\theta_1, \theta_2, \theta_m$：在介质 1、介质 2、薄膜 m 中传播的光的光路与法线之间的夹角。
- $t_{1m}$：从介质 1 侧透射到薄膜侧的光的电场透射系数。
- $t_{m1}$：从薄膜侧透射到介质 1 侧的光的电场透射系数。
- $r_{1m}$：从介质 1 侧来并在 1/m 界面反射的光的电场反射系数。
- $r_{m1}$：从薄膜侧来并在 m/1 界面反射的光的电场反射系数。
- $t_{m2}$：从薄膜侧透射到介质 2 侧的光的电场透射系数。
- $t_{2m}$：从介质 2 侧透射到薄膜侧的光的电场透射系数。
- $r_{m2}$：从薄膜侧来并在 m/2 界面反射的光的电场反射系数。
- $r_{2m}$：从介质 2 侧来并在 1/m 界面反射的光的电场反射系数。
- 上行（−）光：从 m/2 界面朝向 m/1 界面的光。与反射光一样，沿 $-z$ 方向传播。
- 下行（+）光：从 m/1 界面朝向 m/2 界面的光。与入射光一样，沿 $+z$ 方向传播。

（透射系数与反射系数的表达式记载于附录 A。）

> **原文疑点（Q077／Q039关联，2.5 PDF p1）**：底本将 $m/2$ 界面也定义为“介质1与膜之间的界面”，且将 $r_{2m}$ 的反射位置写成 $1/m$。此处均保留原称；候选分别为“膜与介质2之间的界面”和 $2/m$，尚未采用修正。

### 多重反射与透射场

所谓“反射光”，是指在 $1/m$ 界面反射的光，再叠加上进入膜内经多重反射后从 $1/m$ 界面出射的上行（−）光。$1/m$ 界面的边界条件应施加于膜两侧分别叠加了这些多重反射光的总场。

$$
\begin{aligned}
&r_{1m}+t_{1m}t_{m1}r_{m2}\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(r_{m2}r_{m1})^n
 \exp(i2\pi n_m2nh_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda) \\
&=r_{1m}+\frac{t_{1m}t_{m1}r_{m2}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}
 {1-r_{m2}r_{m1}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)} \\
&=\frac{r_{1m}+[-r_{1m}r_{m1}+t_{1m}t_{m1}]r_{m2}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}
 {1-r_{m2}r_{m1}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)} \\
&=\frac{r_{1m}+r_{m2}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}
 {1-r_{m2}r_{m1}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}.
\end{aligned}
\tag{2.1}
$$

> **原文疑点（Q040关联，2.5 PDF p2，式2.1）**：首行求和相位按 $2nh_m$ 写出，$n=0$ 项不带一次往返相位；下一行闭式的分子却含一次往返相位。这里完整保留原来的等号链。候选是在首行求和项之外再乘 $\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)$，或将其相位中的 $n$ 改为 $n+1$；两者均未作为原文修正采用。求和序号 $n$ 与折射率 $n_m$ 不同。

所谓“透射光”，是直接通过薄膜的光与进入膜内经多重反射后从 $m/2$ 界面出射的光叠加而成的。$m/2$ 界面的边界条件应施加于包含这些多重反射光的总场。将入射光的振幅取为1、相位取为 $e^{-i\omega t}$ 时，“透射光”的电场振幅由下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
&t_{1m}t_{m2}\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(r_{m2}r_{m1})^n
 \exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)^n \\
&\qquad\times\exp(i2\pi n_mh_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda) \\
&=\frac{t_{1m}t_{m2}\exp(i2\pi n_mh_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}
 {1-r_{m2}r_{m1}\exp(i2\pi n_m2h_m\cos\theta_m/\lambda)}.
\end{aligned}
\tag{2.3}
$$

> **编号说明（译者）**：底本从式（2.1）直接接至（2.3），随后进入“4.1 激发电场”；此处保留原编号，不补造（2.2）或第3部分。式（2.3）求和中的 $n$ 为整个指数函数的幂，按原排版保留。

## 4.1 激发电场

折射率的数值和波矢的长度依赖于波长，因此红外光与可见光的情况有所不同。（此外，红外光存在吸收，故这些量均为复数。）波长差异由第二下标 ir、vis、SF 来表示。

另外，将电场用表面固定坐标系的坐标分量表示时，使用下述反射系数及透射系数的关系来表示坐标分量：

$$
\begin{aligned}
r_{1m,x} &= -r_{m1,x} = r_{1m,p},\qquad  r_{1m,y} &= -r_{m1,y} = r_{1m,s},\qquad  r_{1m,z} &= -r_{m1,z} = -r_{1m,p} \\
r_{2m,x} &= -r_{m2,x} = r_{2m,p},\qquad  r_{2m,y} &= -r_{m2,y} = r_{2m,s},\qquad  r_{2m,z} &= -r_{m2,z} = -r_{2m,p} \\
t_{1m,x} &= (\cos\theta_m/\cos\theta_1) t_{1m,p},\qquad  t_{1m,y} &= t_{1m,s},\qquad  t_{1m,z} &= (\sin\theta_m/\sin\theta_1) t_{1m,p} \\
t_{m1,x} &= (\cos\theta_1/\cos\theta_m) t_{m1,p},\qquad  t_{m1,y} &= t_{m1,s},\qquad  t_{m1,z} &= (\sin\theta_1/\sin\theta_m) t_{m1,p} \\
t_{2m,x} &= (\cos\theta_m/\cos\theta_2) t_{2m,p},\qquad  t_{2m,y} &= t_{2m,s},\qquad  t_{2m,z} &= (\sin\theta_m/\sin\theta_2) t_{2m,p} \\
t_{m2,x} &= (\cos\theta_2/\cos\theta_m) t_{m2,p},\qquad  t_{m2,y} &= t_{m2,s},\qquad  t_{m2,z} &= (\sin\theta_2/\sin\theta_m) t_{m2,p}
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
t_{1m,\alpha}t_{m1,\alpha} = 1 + r_{1m,\alpha}r_{m1,\alpha} = 1 - r_{1m,\alpha}^2, \quad
t_{2m,\alpha}t_{m2,\alpha} = 1 + r_{2m,\alpha}r_{m2,\alpha} = 1 - r_{2m,\alpha}^2, \quad (\alpha = x, y, z)
$$

### 4.1a. 1/2 系界面外侧（1/2 界面的 1 侧）的激发电场

玻璃表面或金属表面上，在普通表面/界面的介质 1 侧稀疏吸附的分子所感受到的电场，即属于此种情况。

仅存在介质 1 和介质 2 时，界面介质 1 侧的电场等于入射光与反射光的矢量和。因此：

$$
E_{vis,\alpha}(0^-) E_{ir,\beta}(0^-) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta} (1 + r_{12,vis,\alpha})(1 + r_{12,ir,\beta})
\tag{4.3}
$$

其中 $\alpha, \beta = x, y, z$，且 $r_{12,x} = +r_{12,p}$，$r_{12,y} = +r_{12,s}$，$r_{12,z} = -r_{12,p}$。

### 4.1b. 1/2 系界面内侧（1/2 界面的 2 侧）的激发电场

普通表面介质 2 侧或液体界面内侧稀疏吸附的分子所感受到的电场。

由于界面内侧仅存在透射光，因此：

$$
E_{vis,\alpha}(0^+) E_{ir,\beta}(0^+) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta} t_{12,vis,\alpha} t_{12,ir,\beta}
\tag{4.6}
$$

其中 $t_{12,x} = +(\cos\theta_2/\cos\theta_1)t_{12,p}$，$t_{12,y} = +t_{12,s}$，$t_{12,z} = +(\sin\theta_2/\sin\theta_1)t_{12,p}$。

### 4.1c. 1/m/2 系的 1/m 界面的 1 侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^-$) 的激发电场

稀疏吸附的分子所感受到的电场即属于此种情况。

等于 $x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0$ 处的入射光与反射光之和，再加上从薄膜内部出射的光：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(0^-) E_{ir,\beta}(0^-) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\alpha})(1 + r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\beta})(1 + r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.9}
$$

### 4.1d. 1/m/2 系的 1/m 界面的 m 侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^+$) 的激发电场

岛状覆盖层或 1 ML 覆盖层（折射率为 $n$）表面正下方的分子所感受到的电场，即属于此种情况。

等于薄膜内部电场公式（参见附录 C）中上行（−）光与下行（+）光之和：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(0^+) E_{ir,\beta}(0^+) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m,vis,\alpha} t_{1m,ir,\beta} (1 + r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.12}
$$

结果如上。

### 4.1e. 1/m/2 系的 m/2 界面的 2 侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h^+$) 的激发电场

极化来源于透射而来的下行（+）光的电场：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(h_m^+) E_{ir,\beta}(h_m^+) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m,vis,\alpha} t_{m2,vis,\alpha} t_{1m,ir,\beta} t_{m2,ir,\beta} e^{i(\beta_{m,ir}+\beta_{m,vis})h_m}}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,ivis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1 + r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.15}
$$

> **原文疑点（Q085，PDF p3，式4.15）**：可见光分母原写 $r_{m2,ivis,\alpha}$，保留其中的 $ivis$；候选 $vis$ 未采用。该小节标题中的位置原写 $z=h^+$，未补膜下标。


### 4.1f. 1/m/2 系的 m/2 界面的 m 侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h^-$) 的激发电场

等于上行（−）光与下行（+）光之和：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(h_m^-) E_{ir,\beta}(h_m^-) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m,vis,\alpha} t_{1m,ir,\beta} (1 + r_{m2,vis,\alpha})(1+ r_{m2,ir,\beta}) e^{i(\beta_{m,ir}+\beta_{m,vis})h_m}}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.18}
$$

### 4.1g. 1/m/2 系的薄膜内部 $[0 < z < h_m]$ 的激发电场

在以下公式中，取 $k_m[x\sin\theta + z\cos\theta]$ 时需要注意 $h_m$ 的引入方式。

**$[B_{n=-1,0,1,2} : x = -(2(n + 1)h_m - z)\tan\theta_{m,SF}]$: $E^+$ 源点**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(z) E_{ir,\beta}(z) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m,vis,\alpha} t_{1m,ir,\beta}}
{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1 + r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[-i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})] \\
&\times \{\exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,ir,\beta} e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\alpha} e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,ir,\beta} e^{2i(\beta_{m,vis}+\beta_{m,ir})h_m} \\
&\quad \times \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr]\}
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.21}
$$

**$[A_{n=0,1,2} : x = -(2n h_m + z)\tan\theta_{m,SF}]$: $E^-$ 源点**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(z) E_{ir,\beta}(z) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m,vis,\alpha} t_{1m,ir,\beta}}
{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1 + r_{1m,ir,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[-i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})] \\
&\times \{\exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,ir,\beta} e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\alpha} e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,ir,\beta} e^{2i(\beta_{m,vis}+\beta_{m,ir})h_m} \\
&\quad \times \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr]\}
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.24}
$$





> **原文疑点（Q044／Q047关联，PDF p3—4）**：4.1g的B源点位置为 $x=-(2(n+1)h_m-z)\tan\theta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}$，而式4.21外部相位含 $2n+1$；两处原值保留。4.1d引用附录C，但本独立文件实际只附A与D，不补造C。

## 4.2 和频极化

和频极化矢量 $\mathbf{P}$ 的坐标轴分量 $P_\alpha (\alpha = x, y, z)$ 由二阶非线性极化率张量 $\chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma}$ 以下式给出。其中下标 $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ 从左到右依次对应 SFG 光、可见光、红外光。

$$
P_\alpha = \sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E_{vis,\beta} E_{ir,\gamma}
\tag{4.25}
$$

下面按 SFG 光产生的不同部位分别考察来自薄膜的 和频极化。

### 4.2a. 1/m 界面外侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^-$) 的 和频极化

突出在表面或稀疏分布的分子由表面电场极化。因此，由 (4.9) 式，点 $(x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^-)$ 处的极化由下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(0^-, n) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\beta})(1+ r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\gamma})(1+ r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]\big\} \\
= &P_\alpha(0^-, n=0) \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]\big\}
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.26a}
$$

然而，当表面形成完整薄膜时，分子所感受到的电场及极化需将薄膜记为 $m'$，按下式进行改写：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{vis,\alpha}(h_{m'}) E_{ir,\beta}(h_{m'}) = E^0_{vis,\alpha} E^0_{ir,\beta}
&\frac{t_{1m',vis,\alpha} (1+ r_{m'm,vis,\alpha})(1 + r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})}
{1 + r_{1m',vis,\alpha} r_{m'm,vis,\alpha} + (r_{m'm,vis,\alpha} + r_{1m',vis,\alpha}) r_{m2,vis,\alpha}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m}} \\
\times &\frac{t_{1m',ir,\beta} (1+ r_{m'm,ir,\beta})(1 + r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{1+ r_{1m',ir,\beta} r_{m'm,ir,\beta} + (r_{m'm,ir,\beta} + r_{1m',ir,\beta}) r_{m2,ir,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m}} \\
\times &\exp[-2i n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} + k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
$$

由此：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(0^-) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m',vis,\beta} (1+ r_{m'm,vis,\beta})(1 + r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})}
{1+ r_{1m',vis,\beta} r_{m'm,vis,\beta} + (r_{m'm,vis,\beta} + r_{1m',vis,\beta}) r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m}} \\
\times &\frac{t_{1m',ir,\gamma} (1+ r_{m'm,ir,\gamma})(1 + r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{1+ r_{1m',ir,\gamma} r_{m'm,ir,\gamma} + (r_{m'm,ir,\gamma} + r_{1m',ir,\gamma}) r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m}} \\
\times &\exp[-2i n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} + k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})] \\
= &P_\alpha(0^-, n=0) \exp[-2i n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} + k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.26b}
$$

### 4.2b. 1/m 界面内侧 ($x = -2n h\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^+$) 的 和频极化

薄膜内部，或气液界面液体侧的分子的极化，由 (4.13) 式以下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(0^+) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{1m,ir,\gamma} (1 + r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1 + r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})] \\
= &P_\alpha(0^+, n=0) \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.27}
$$

### 4.2c. m/2 界面外侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^+$) 的 和频极化

突出于薄膜背面的分子的极化，由 (4.15) 式以下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(h_m^+) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{m2,vis,\beta} t_{1m,ir,\gamma} t_{m2,ir,\gamma} e^{i(\beta_{m,ir}+\beta_{m,vis})h_m}}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,wvis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})] \\
= &P_\alpha(h_m^+, n=0) \exp[2i n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.28a}
$$

当薄膜 $m''$ 为极化层时：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(h_m^+) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{mm'',vis,\beta} (1+ r_{m''2,vis,\beta}) e^{i\beta_{m,vis}h_m}}
{(1 + r_{mm'',vis,\beta} r_{m''2,vis,\beta}) + r_{1m,vis,\beta} (r_{mm'',vis,\beta} + r_{m''2,vis,\beta}) e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m}} \\
\times &\frac{t_{1m,ir,\gamma} t_{mm'',ir,\gamma} (1 + r_{m''2,ir,\gamma}) e^{i\beta_{m,ir}h_m}}
{(1+ r_{mm'',ir,\gamma} r_{m''2,ir,\gamma}) + r_{1m,ir,\gamma} (r_{mm'',ir,\gamma} + r_{m''2,ir,\gamma}) e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m}} \\
\times &\exp[i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})] \\
= &P_\alpha(h_m^+, n=0) \exp[2i n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.28b}
$$

$$
E_{vis,\alpha}(m') = E^0_{vis,\alpha} \frac{(1+ r_{m2,vis,\alpha}) t_{1m',vis,\alpha} t_{m'm,vis,\alpha} e^{i\beta_{m',vis}h_{m'}}}
{(1 + r_{m'm,vis,\alpha} r_{m2,vis,\alpha}) + r_{1m',vis,\alpha} (r_{m'm,vis,\alpha} + r_{m2,vis,\alpha}) e^{2i\beta_{m',vis}h_{m'}}}
$$

### 4.2d. m/2 界面内侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^-$) 的 和频极化

薄膜背面界面处、薄膜内部分子的极化，由 (4.18) 式以下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(h_m^-) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}e
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{1m,ir,\gamma} (1+ r_{m2,vis,\beta})(1+ r_{m2,ir,\gamma}) e^{i(\beta_{m,ir}+\beta_{m,vis})h_m}}
{(1 + r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1+ r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[i(2n + 1)h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})] \\
= &P_\alpha(h_m^-, n=0) \exp[i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(-k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.29}
$$

### 4.2e. 薄膜体相 [$0 < z < h_m$] 的 和频极化

对 $A_{n=0,1,2} : x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF} - z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$ 及 $B_{n=-1,0,1,2} : x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF} + z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$，由 (4.21) 式以下式给出。

[$B_n$]: $E^+$ 源点

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(z) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{1m,ir,\gamma}}
{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})(1 + r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})} \\
&\times \exp[-2i h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})] \\
&\times \{\exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,ir,\gamma} e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\beta} e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\gamma} e^{2i(\beta_{m,vis}+\beta_{m,ir})h_m} \\
&\quad \times \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr]\} \\
&\times \exp[-i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})] \\
= &P_\alpha(z, n=0) \exp[-i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.30a}
$$

[$A_n$]: $E^-$ 源点

由 (4.24) 式以下式给出：

$$
\begin{aligned}
P_\alpha(z) = &\sum_{\beta,\gamma} \chi_{\alpha\beta\gamma} E^0_{vis,\beta} E^0_{ir,\gamma}
\frac{t_{1m,vis,\beta} t_{1m,ir,\gamma}}
{(1+ r_{1m,vis,\beta} r_{m2,vis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m})(1 + r_{1m,ir,\gamma} r_{m2,ir,\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m})} \\
&\times \{\exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,ir,\gamma} e^{2i\beta_{m,ir}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\beta} e^{2i\beta_{m,vis}h_m} \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&+ k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1-\tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr] \\
&+ r_{m2,vis,\beta} r_{m2,ir,\gamma} e^{2i(\beta_{m,vis}+\beta_{m,ir})h_m} \\
&\quad \times \exp\bigl[iz\bigl(\begin{aligned}&-k_{m,vis}\cos\theta_{m,vis}(1+ \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,vis})\\&- k_{m,ir}\cos\theta_{m,ir}(1 + \tan\theta_{m,SF}\tan\theta_{m,ir})\end{aligned}\bigr)\bigr]\} \\
&\times \exp[-i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})] \\
= &P_\alpha(z, n=0) \exp[-i 2n h_m \tan\theta_{m,SF}(k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} + k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir})]
\end{aligned}
\tag{4.30b}
$$

对于无限薄片状极化的情况，T. Heinz 等人已经阐明了由此产生的光的性质。因此，下面基于他们的工作展开讨论。



> **原文疑点（Q061／Q062／Q063关联，PDF p4—6）**：式4.26a的两行相位之后各有未配对右花括号，照录可见符号；4.28a写 $wvis$；4.29在两入射场后有孤立 $e$。这些均不以旧译的规范化形式代替原文。



> **原文疑点（Q064／Q047关联，PDF p5—7）**：4.30a的vis反射系数配ir相位、ir系数配vis相位，且另有不含求和序号n的外部相位；均保留。4.2b按原文引用4.13，而本独立文件此处激发场编号为4.12；不改号。

> **原文记号说明（Q085关联，PDF p5）**：4.2b标题写 $x=-2nh\tan\theta_{m,SF}$，保留无m下标的 $h$；未从相邻标题补入下标。

## 5.1 L 系数、电场振幅

L 系数是联系极化与由其产生的光的电场振幅的系数。

$$
E_{SF,\alpha} = \sum_{\beta} L_{\alpha\beta} P_\beta^{SF}
$$

根据推广的 斯涅尔 折射定律，产生的 SFG 光同时包含上行（−）光和上行（+）光（原文称谓）。此外，L 系数的表达式因极化位置不同而异。原始推导的公式考虑了无限薄薄膜 m 极化后出射到介质 1 和介质 2 中的光，将 s 偏振和 p 偏振的电场振幅与极化的 x、y、z 分量联系在一起。此处对此进行扩展。另外，共同因子 $4\pi i \omega_{SF}/c$（当使用波数矢量代替折射率时为 $4\pi i \omega_{SF}^2/c^2$）在此省略。

L 系数的记法：$L_{i/j, s(p), \alpha}$ 表示当极化片 $m'$ 夹在 $i$ 层与 $j$ 层之间时，极化的 $\alpha$ 分量（$\alpha = x, y, z$）到其产生的光中 s 偏振或 p 偏振分量（非坐标轴分量）的系数。上行（−）光与上行（+）光（原文称谓）的区分，以上标 $-$ 和 $+$ 表示。

对于位于介质 1 与层叠薄膜 m 之间的极化片 $m'$ 所产生的光：

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{1/m,p,x} &= \cos\theta_{m,SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.1a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{1/m,s,y} &= 1/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.1b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{1/m,p,z} &= (n_{m,SF}/n_{m',SF})\sin\theta_{m',SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF}) \\
               &= (n_{m,SF}/n_{m',SF})^2 \sin\theta_{m,SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.1c}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{1/m,p,x} &= \cos\theta_{1,SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.2a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{1/m,s,y} &= 1/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.2b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{1/m,p,z} &= -(n_{1,SF}/n_{m',SF})\sin\theta_{m',SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF}) \\
               &= -(n_{1,SF}/n_{m',SF})^2 \sin\theta_{1,SF}/(n_{1,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{1,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.2c}
$$

对于位于介质 2 与层叠薄膜 m 之间的极化片 $m''$ 所产生的光：

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{2/m,p,x} &= \cos\theta_{2,SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.3a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{2/m,s,y} &= 1/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.3b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{2/m,p,z} &= (n_{2,SF}/n_{m'',SF})\sin\theta_{m'',SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF}) \\
               &= (n_{2,SF}/n_{m'',SF})^2 \sin\theta_{2,SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.3c}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{2/m,p,x} &= \cos\theta_{m,SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.4a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{2/m,s,y} &= 1/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.4b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^+_{2/m,p,z} &= -(n_{m,SF}/n_{m'',SF})\sin\theta_{m'',SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF}) \\
               &= -(n_{m,SF}/n_{m'',SF})^2 \sin\theta_{m,SF}/(n_{2,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF} + n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{2,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.4c}
$$

对于层叠薄膜内部的极化片所产生的光：

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{m/m,p,x} &= L^+_{m/m,p,x} = \cos\theta_{m,SF}/(2 n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.5a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{m/m,s,y} &= L^+_{m/m,s,y} = 1/(2 n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.5b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
L^-_{m/m,p,z} &= -L^+_{m/m,p,z} = \sin\theta_{m,SF}/(2 n_{m,SF}\cos\theta_{m,SF})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.5c}
$$

由此，各部位产生的 SFG 光的电场振幅表示如下。

**来源于 $P(0)$ 的项**（$P(0^-)$ 为介质 1 侧电场引起的极化，$P(0^+)$ 为薄膜侧电场引起的极化）：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1,p}(z = 0) &= L^-_{1/m,p,x} P_x(0) + L^-_{1/m,p,z} P_z(0)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.6a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1,s}(z = 0) &= L^-_{1/m,s,y} P_y(0)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.6b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{m,p}(z = 0) &= L^+_{1/m,p,x} P_x(0) + L^+_{1/m,p,z} P_z(0)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.7a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{m,s}(z = 0) &= L^+_{1/m,s,y} P_y(0)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.7b}
$$

**来源于 $P(h_m)$ 的项**（$P(h_m^+)$ 为介质 2 侧电场引起的极化，$P(h_m^-)$ 为薄膜侧电场引起的极化）：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{m,p}(z = h_m) &= L^-_{2/m,p,x} P_x(h_m) + L^-_{2/m,p,z} P_z(h_m)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.8a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{m,s}(z = h_m) &= L^-_{2/m,s,y} P_y(h_m)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.8b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2,p}(z = h_m) &= L^+_{2/m,p,x} P_x(h_m) + L^+_{2/m,p,z} P_z(h_m)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.9a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2,s}(z = h_m) &= L^+_{2/m,s,y} P_y(h_m)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.9b}
$$

**来源于 $P(z)$ 的项**：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{m,p}(z) &= L^-_{m/m,p,x} P_x(z) + L^-_{m/m,p,z} P_z(z)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.10a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{m,s}(z) &= L^-_{m/m,s,y} P_y(z)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.10b}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{m,p}(z) &= L^+_{m/m,p,x} P_x(z) + L^+_{m/m,p,z} P_z(z)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.11a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{m,s}(z) &= L^+_{m/m,s,y} P_y(z)
\end{aligned}\tag{5.11b}
$$



> **原文疑点（Q041关联，PDF p7）**：本段两次将“+”光也写作上向。这里保留原称；下行仅为候选名称，不改系数符号。式5.6—5.9的场与极化位置按原文只写0或 $h_m$，不从2.4移入其两侧上标，也不移入该文件的 $P_y(00^+)$ 字样。

## 5.2a. 1/m 界面外侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^-$) 的反射 SFG

（同时使用 $1/\cos\theta = \cos\theta + \sin\theta\tan\theta$ 的关系式，反射率和透射率的下标 SF 省略后，将 p 偏振或 s 偏振的电场振幅记为 $E_t$，极化的 x、y、z 分量记为 $P_a$。）

也使用了 $k_{m,SF}\sin\theta_{m,SF} - k_{m,vis}\sin\theta_{m,vis} - k_{m,ir}\sin\theta_{m,ir} = 0$ 的关系式进行了整理。

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+(1-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.13a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{1s}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.13b}
$$

当表面形成完整薄膜时，对于构成该薄膜（折射率为 $m'$）的分子的 SFG，需要考虑薄膜内部的多次反射。

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},p})[(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+(1-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}]}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}(r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},p})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.14a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1s}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},s})[(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}]}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}(r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},s})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.14b}
$$

## 5.2b. 1/m 界面内侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^+$) 的反射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\

$$
\begin{aligned}

&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{-}_{1/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}

## 5.2c. m/2 界面外侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^+$) 的反射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,wvis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,p}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{1+r_{1m,p}r_{m2,p}\,2e^{2\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}(L^{-}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{-}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})

&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,s}e^{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{1+r_{1m,s}r_{m2,s}\,2e^{2\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}L^{-}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}

当产生 SFG 的界面为折射率 $m''$ 的薄膜时：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p})}{1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}(L^{-}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{-}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})

\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1s}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s})}{1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}L^{-}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}

## 5.2d. m/2 界面内侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^-$) 的反射 SFG

\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}(L^{-}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{-}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})

&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}L^{-}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}

> **原文疑点（Q082关联，PDF p10，式5.16a/b）**：保留 $wvis$、省略SF的系数下标、分母基线数字2及随后指数缺i的写法；5.16b出射分子指数亦未见i。常规分母与相位仅列为候选，不用于正文。

## 5.2e. 薄膜体相 [$0 < z < h_m$] 的反射 SFG

源点位置按底本为：$0<z<h_m$；$A_n$（$n=0,1,2$）满足 $x=-2nh_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}-z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$；$B_n$（$n=-1,0,1,2$）满足 $x=-(2n+1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}+z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$。

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1p}(0^-)&=\frac{i}{\delta}\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}\frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times\big\{\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{x\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,p,x}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})] \\
&\qquad+\chi_{z\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,p,z}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})\\
&\qquad-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})]\big\} \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{x\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,p,x}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})] \\
&\qquad+\chi_{z\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,p,z}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})\\
&\qquad-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})]\big\} \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{x\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,p,x}[r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m})] \\
&\qquad+\chi_{z\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,p,z}[r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})\\
&\qquad-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m})]\big\} \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{x\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,p,x}[(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1)\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})] \\
&\qquad+\chi_{z\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,p,z}[(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1)\\
&\qquad-r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})]\big\}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.19a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^-_{1s}(0^-)&=\frac{i}{\delta}\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}\frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times\big\{\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{y\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,s,y}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})] \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{y\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{1/m,s,y}[r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})] \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{y\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,s,y}[r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m})] \\
&\quad+\frac{1}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\{\chi_{y\beta\gamma}L^{-}_{m/m,s,y}[(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1)\\
&\qquad+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m})]
\end{aligned}\tag{5.19b}
$$

## 5.2f. 净反射 SFG 电场

实际观测到的 SFG 光的电场，是所有产生部位产生的 SFG 光电场沿光路叠加求和的结果。因此，对上述各式求和，其"和的平方"即为 SFG 光强度。



> **原文疑点（Q084／Q053关联，PDF p11—12）**：5.19前因子为 $i/\delta$，旧译 $i\delta$ 已按原页恢复。vis/ir交叉相位、前两项1/m与后两项m/m层标混用及原花括号闭合不齐均照录。净场强度的“和的平方”也按原措辞保留；复振幅可观测强度通常涉及模平方，此处不擅改作者表述。

## 5.3 透射 SFG 的电场

在考虑透射 SFG 时，除了上述反射 SFG 中已考虑的部分外，还必须纳入 $x = 0 \sim h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}$ 范围（以及 m/2 界面外侧）的贡献。

### 5.3a. 1/m 界面外侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^-$) 的透射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}(L^{+}_{m/1,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{+}_{m/1,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.20a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}L^{+}_{m/1,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.20b}
$$

当发光层为薄膜 $m'$ 时：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}(1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},p})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}(r_{mm',\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m'1,\mathrm{SF},p})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}\mathclose{)}(L^{+}_{1/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{+}_{1/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.21a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{1m',\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{1m',\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m'm,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}(1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},s})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{1+r_{1m',\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m'm,\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}(r_{mm',\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m'1,\mathrm{SF},s})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}\mathclose{)}L^{+}_{1/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.21b}
$$

### 5.3b. 1/m 界面内侧 ($x = -2n h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = 0^+$) 的透射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}(L^{+}_{1/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+L^{+}_{1/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma})
\end{aligned}\tag{5.22a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}L^{+}_{1/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.22b}
$$

### 5.3c. m/2 界面外侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^+$) 的透射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,wvis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1-r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.23a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,wvis,\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1-r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.23b}
$$

### 5.3d. m/2 界面内侧 ($x = -(2n + 1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}, z = h_m^-$) 的透射 SFG

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+(-1+r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.24a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})(1+r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}})h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.24b}
$$

当背面 和频极化由薄膜 ($m''$) 引起时：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p})[(1-r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}+(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}]}{1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},p}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},p})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.25a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{vis},\beta}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{vis},\beta})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}t_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(1+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}}{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{ir},\gamma}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}} \\
&\quad\times \frac{(1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s})[(1-r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})L^{+}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}]}{1+r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}(r_{mm^{\prime\prime},\mathrm{SF},s}+r_{m^{\prime\prime}2,\mathrm{SF},s})e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.25b}
$$



> **原文疑点（Q080／Q081／Q083关联，PDF p12—14）**：5.20的L层标为m/1；5.21分母末项用反向界面下标且带未配对右括号；5.24有孤立e；5.25左端缺“+”。分别保留原值，不把相邻公式代为统一。

### 5.3e. 薄膜体相 [$0 < z < h_m$] 的透射 SFG

源点位置按底本为：$0<z<h_m$；$A_n$（$n=0,1,2$）满足 $x=-2nh_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}-z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$；$B_n$（$n=-1,0,1,2$）满足 $x=-(2n+1)h_m\tan\theta_{m,SF}+z\tan\theta_{m,SF}$。

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2p}(h_m^+)&=\frac{i}{\delta}\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}\frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},p}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times\big\{L^{+}_{2/m,p,x}\chi_{x\beta\gamma}\big[ \\
&\qquad\frac{[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}[1-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big] \\
&\quad+L^{+}_{2/m,p,z}\chi_{z\beta\gamma}\big[ \\
&\qquad\frac{[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad-\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad-\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad-\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad-\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},p}[1-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big]\big\}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.26a}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^+_{2s}(h_m^+)&=\frac{i}{\delta}\sum_{\beta,\gamma}E^0_{\mathrm{vis},\beta}E^0_{\mathrm{ir},\gamma} \\
&\quad\times \frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m})}\frac{t_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times \frac{e^{i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m}}{(1+r_{1m,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{SF},s}e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}h_m})} \\
&\quad\times L^{+}_{2/m,s,y}\chi_{y\beta\gamma}\big\{ \\
&\qquad\frac{[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-1]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{2i\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}h_m}-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}-\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m2,\mathrm{vis},\beta}r_{m2,\mathrm{ir},\gamma}[e^{i(-\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}-e^{2i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}} \\
&\qquad+\frac{r_{m1,\mathrm{SF},s}[1-e^{i(\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}})h_m}]}{\beta_{m,\mathrm{SF}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{vis}}+\beta_{m,\mathrm{ir}}}\big\}
\end{aligned}\tag{5.26b}
$$

## 5.4 净透射 SFG 电场

实际观测到的 SFG 光的电场，是所有部位产生的 SFG 光电场叠加求和的结果。因此，对上述各式求和，其"和的平方"即为 SFG 光强度。

---



> **原文疑点（Q084／Q053关联，PDF p15—16）**：5.26的前因子同样为 $i/\delta$；未把旧译乘积当作原式。净透射场的“和的平方”按原措辞保留。长式同分母分子拆为分行分式，仅为排版，各项完整展开。


> **文字补读（E-2.5-001，PDF p15，5.4）**：底本写「べての部分」，暂按「すべての部分」理解，译为“所有部位”；这是未获作者确认的文字补读，已登记勘误附件。

## 附录A. 线性光学的主要关系式

频率为 $\omega$ 的平面波，在时刻 $t$、位置 $\boldsymbol r$ 处的电场矢量，可用指数函数表示为：

$$
\boldsymbol E_\omega(\boldsymbol r,t)=\boldsymbol E_\omega^0\exp[i(\omega t-\boldsymbol k\cdot\boldsymbol r)]+\mathrm{c.c.}\tag{A.1}
$$

这里 $\boldsymbol k$ 是波矢，c.c.表示紧邻前项的复共轭。由 $\exp(\pm i\alpha)=\cos\alpha\pm i\sin\alpha$，上式为实数。对于单频平面波，可以用波矢替代麦克斯韦方程中的微分算符 $\boldsymbol\nabla$，由此导出式（A.1）。设波长为 $\lambda$、折射率为 $n$、介电常数为 $\varepsilon$，有：

$$
k=2\pi/\lambda=2n\pi/\lambda_0,\qquad c=\omega/k_0,\qquad\varepsilon=c^2k^2/\omega^2,\qquad n=ck/\omega.\tag{A.2}
$$

下标0表示真空中的值。在具有吸收的介质中，使用：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon&=1+4\pi\chi,\qquad\chi=\chi\prime+i\chi\prime\prime,\\
n&=n(1+i\kappa),\qquad n^2(1-\kappa^2)=\mu+4\pi\mu\chi\prime,\\
n^2\kappa&=2\pi\mu\chi\prime\prime.
\end{aligned}\tag{A.3}
$$

$\kappa$：衰减指数、消光指数。

这里的 $\chi$ 是线性极化率，区别于本节和频正文中的二阶非线性极化率。

金属的折射率有几种不同的表示方式。例如，Born与Wolf的教科书采用 $n(1+i\kappa)$，APS手册采用 $n-i\kappa$；虚部的符号有两种约定。不论采取哪种记法，只要给金属表面赋予复折射率，就可以应用斯涅尔定律。

Born与Wolf的教科书在应用斯涅尔定律时，将折射率 $n_2$ 与折射角 $\theta_2$ 取为复数，并给出以下定义。下标1、2分别表示入射侧与透射侧。设金属表面折射率如下，空气折射率为1：

$$
n_2=n_2(1+i\kappa_2)=n_2+in_2\kappa_2\tag{A.4}
$$
$$
n_2\cos\theta_2=u_2+iv_2\tag{A.5}
$$

其中 $u_2,v_2$ 是下式定义的实数，底本注明 $u_2v_2\leq0$：

$$
u_2^2=\frac12\left\{\left[n_2^2(1-\kappa_2^2)-n_1^2\sin^2\theta_1^{2}\right]+\sqrt{\left[n_2^2(1-\kappa_2^2)-n_1^2\sin^2\theta_1^{2}\right]^2+4n_2^2\kappa_2^2}\right\}\tag{A.6a}
$$
$$
v_2^2=\frac12\left\{-\left[n_2^2(1-\kappa_2^2)-n_1^2\sin^2\theta_1^{2}\right]+\sqrt{\left[n_2^2(1-\kappa_2^2)-n_1^2\sin^2\theta_1^{2}\right]^2+4n_2^2\kappa_2^2}\right\}\tag{A.6b}
$$

> **译校注（Q073，保留原式）：** 本独立底本式（A.6a、b）的四处角度项均印为 $\sin^2\theta_1^{2}$，即角度符号本身还带上标2；此处保留该字形。额外的2是否为排版遗留未决，候选 $\sin^2\theta_1$ 未采用。2.5 PDF p16亦有同样四处额外上标；已逐项对原页保留，属于转写恢复。

> **译校注（关联第2.2节Q053，局部约定）：** 式（A.1）使用 $e^{+i\omega t}$，本节前部的透射场约定使用 $e^{-i\omega t}$；本附录还并列两种复折射率虚部符号。各处照录，不能脱离时间因子、传播方向和衰减条件直接互换。式（A.6）的根号支路与 $u_2v_2\leq0$ 的配合也需复核。

### 反射与折射

讨论界面处的反射与折射时，用斯涅尔定律确定折射角，用菲涅尔因子确定反射与透射。二者都由界面边界条件导出，即：

- $\boldsymbol k,\boldsymbol E,\boldsymbol H$ 的面内分量在界面两侧相等。
- $\boldsymbol D=\varepsilon\boldsymbol E$、$\boldsymbol B=\mu\boldsymbol H$ 的法向分量在界面两侧相等。

在入射侧，应取入射光与反射光的矢量和；在透射侧，只取透射光矢量。若薄膜另一面的反射光与入射光叠加，则还要加入这部分贡献，即膜内多重反射光的电场，再对总场应用边界条件。

> **译校注：** 上述边界条件按底本概括保留。$\boldsymbol k$ 的切向匹配针对各波相位，不能像电场那样将入射、反射波矢相加；电磁场连续条件还隐含无相应自由面电荷、面电流等前提。该适用范围问题归入关联第2.2节Q053。

### 反射系数与透射系数

如另文《菲涅尔因子等》所述，将入射光分为s、p两种偏振，分别求反射光与透射光振幅相对于入射振幅 $E_s^i,E_p^i$ 的比，得到振幅反射系数、透射系数。电场振幅的下标表示偏振，上标 $i,r,t$ 区分入射、反射、透射。系数的上标表示偏振，下标左端表示光入射的介质，右端表示透射到的介质。

反射系数为：

$$
\begin{aligned}
r_{12}^s&=E_r^s/E_i^s=(k_{1z}-k_{2z})/(k_{1z}+k_{2z})\\
&=(n_1\cos\theta_1-n_2\cos\theta_2)/(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2)\\
&=-\sin(\theta_1-\theta_2)/\sin(\theta_1+\theta_2),\\
r_{12}^p&=E_r^p/E_i^p=(\varepsilon_1k_{2z}-\varepsilon_2k_{1z})/(\varepsilon_2k_{1z}+\varepsilon_1k_{2z})\\
&=(n_1\cos\theta_2-n_2\cos\theta_1)/(n_2\cos\theta_1+n_1\cos\theta_2)\\
&=-\tan(\theta_1-\theta_2)/\tan(\theta_1+\theta_2).
\end{aligned}\tag{A.7}
$$

透射系数为：

$$
\begin{aligned}
t_{12}^s&=E_t^s/E_i^s=2k_{1z}/(k_{1z}+k_{2z})\\
&=2n_1\cos\theta_1/(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2)\\
&=2\cos\theta_1\sin\theta_2/\sin(\theta_1+\theta_2),\\
t_{12}^p&=E_t^p/E_i^p=2\varepsilon_1k_{2z}\cos\theta_1/(\varepsilon_2k_{1z}+\varepsilon_1k_{2z})\\
&=2n_1\cos\theta_1/(n_2\cos\theta_1+n_1\cos\theta_2)\\
&=2\cos\theta_1\sin\theta_2/\sin(\theta_1+\theta_2)\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2).
\end{aligned}\tag{A.8}
$$

本稿 $r_{12}^p$ 的符号与Born与Wolf教科书中的表达式相反。这是为了使入射角小于布儒斯特角时，电场面内分量（$x,y$ 分量）的符号相同。用 $\varepsilon$ 和 $k$ 表示的形式，适用于处理吸收介质或金属表面的反射。

对于从介质2反向传播至介质1的光，有：

$$
r_{21}^s=-r_{12}^s,\qquad r_{21}^p=-r_{12}^p\tag{A.9a}
$$
$$
t_{21}^s=(n_2\cos\theta_2/n_1\cos\theta_1)t_{12}^s,\qquad t_{21}^p=(n_2\cos\theta_2/n_1\cos\theta_1)t_{12}^p\tag{A.9b}
$$

以界面向内法线为 $z$ 轴，以s偏振电场方向为 $y$ 轴，取 $x$ 轴正向与光沿界面的传播方向一致。电场坐标分量为：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E_{x,i}&=E_i^p\cos\theta_1,\quad E_{y,i}=E_{ri}^s,\quad E_{z,i}=-E_i^p\sin\theta_1,\\
E_{x,r}&=E_r^p\cos\theta_1,\quad E_{y,r}=E_r^s,\quad E_{z,r}=E_r^p\sin\theta_1,\\
E_{x,t}&=E_t^p\cos\theta_2,\quad E_{y,t}=E_t^s,\quad E_{z,t}=-E_t^p\sin\theta_2.
\end{aligned}
$$

由此得到：

$$
r_{12}^x=r_{12}^p,\quad r_{12}^y=r_{12}^s,\quad r_{12}^z=-r_{12}^p\tag{A.10a}
$$
$$
r_{21}^x=-r_{12}^p,\quad r_{21}^y=-r_{12}^s,\quad r_{21}^z=r_{12}^p\tag{A.10b}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
t_{12}^x&=(\cos\theta_2/\cos\theta_1)t_{12}^p,\quad t_{12}^y=t_{12}^s,\\
t_{12}^z&=(\sin\theta_2/\sin\theta_1)t_{12}^p=(n_1/n_2)t_{12}^p
\end{aligned}\tag{A.11a}
$$
$$
t_{21}^x=(n_2/n_1)t_{12}^p,\quad t_{12}^y=t_{12}^s,\quad t_{12}^z=(\cos\theta_2/\cos\theta_1)(n_2/n_1)^2t_{12}^p\tag{A.11b}
$$

> **译校注（关联第2.2节Q072，保留原式）：** 式（A.3、A.4）同用 $n$ 表示复量与实量；轴向分量首行写 $E^s_{ri}$；（A.11b）首项为 $t^x_{21}$，随后两项却为 $t^y_{12},t^z_{12}$。式（A.8）末行采用原有斜线与连乘写法，括号作用范围不作补改。这些记号按原式保留，复数与边界条件约定另见关联第2.2节Q053。

这些表达式满足下列关系；首行对应电场边界条件：

$$
1+r_{12}^x=t_{12}^x,\quad1+r_{12}^y=t_{12}^y,\quad1+r_{12}^z=(n_2/n_1)^2t_{12}^z
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
1+r_{12}^sr_{21}^s&=1-(r_{12}^s)^2=t_{12}^st_{21}^s,\\
1+r_{12}^pr_{21}^p&=1-(r_{12}^p)^2=t_{12}^pt_{21}^p.
\end{aligned}\tag{A.12}
$$

光强正比于 $nE^2\cos\theta$，因此有 $n_1\cos\theta_1\,r_{12}^2+n_2\cos\theta_2\,t_{12}^2=n_1\cos\theta_1$，体现光强守恒。

> **译校注（关联第2.2节Q053，适用范围）：** 此处平方与守恒关系保留底本形式；一般复振幅需取模平方，且有吸收时须另行计入吸收。不能把本段的无损形式直接用于上文所有复折射率情形。




> **独立底本说明（译者）**：以上A.1—A.12已对2.5 PDF p16—18重核；采用正时间指数，χ为线性极化率。A.6角度额外平方、入射y场的ri下标及反向t21/t12混写等均保留；不从其他章节带入已推定的修正。

## 附录D. 介质之间极化薄片的L系数

底本所称正文的“式（4.29）—（4.32）”，是将极化薄片所产生的SFG光经过无限薄片内多重反射、向两侧介质出射时的电场与极化联系起来的系数。下面从底本所称的片内L系数“式（4.33）—（4.36）”出发加以证明。

若介质1或介质2的厚度有限，必须考虑其中的多重反射，则下述分析还不充分，上述“式（4.29）—（4.32）”严格说来不能直接使用。

> **译校注（关联第2.2节Q047，保留原引用）：** 本独立PDF的4.29—4.30为极化表达式，所引用4.29—4.36并非本节L系数编号。本节界面和片内L系数集中于5.1，式（5.1a）—（5.5c）；这里只提供定位线索，不建立未经验证的一一换号关系。

考虑夹在介质1与介质2之间的极化薄片 $m$。向介质1侧出射的是上行（−）SFG光；计入片内多重反射后，各分量如下。

**s偏振：来自 $P_y$ 的贡献。**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{-}_{\mathrm{SF},s}&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,y}P_y\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,s}r_{m2,s}}+L^+_{m/m,y}P_y\frac{r_{m2,s}}{1-r_{m1,s}r_{m2,s}}\Bigr]t_{m1,s}\\
&=\frac{P_y}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_2+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2\right)}\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_2+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}\\
&=\frac{P_y}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2\right)}=L^{-}_{1/2,y}P_y
\end{aligned}
$$

**p偏振：来自 $P_x$ 的贡献。** 推导跨独立PDF p18—19：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{-}_{\mathrm{SF},p}(\text{来自 }P_x)&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,x}P_x\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}+L^+_{m/m,x}P_x\frac{r_{m2,p}}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}\Bigr]t_{m1,p}\\
&=\frac{\cos\theta_m}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}P_x\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_2}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}\\
&=\frac{\cos\theta_2}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_x=L^{-}_{1/2,x}P_x
\end{aligned}
$$

<!-- 介质1侧Px推导跨页续式已并入前式。 -->

**p偏振：来自 $P_z$ 的贡献。**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{-}_{\mathrm{SF},p}(\text{来自 }P_z)&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,z}P_z\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}-L^+_{m/m,z}P_z\frac{r_{m2,p}}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}\Bigr]t_{m1,p}\\
&=\frac{\sin\theta_m}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}P_z\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_2\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}\\
&=\frac{(n_2/n_m)\sin\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_z=\frac{(n_2/n_m)^2\sin\theta_2}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_z=L^{-}_{1/2,z}P_z
\end{aligned}
$$

另一方面，向介质2侧出射的是下行（+）SFG光。计入片内多重反射，各分量如下。

**s偏振：来自 $P_y$ 的贡献。**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{+}_{\mathrm{SF},s}&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,y}P_y\frac{r_{m1,s}}{1-r_{m1,s}r_{m2,s}}+L^+_{m/m,y}P_y\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,s}r_{m2,s}}\Bigr]t_{m2,s}\\
&=\frac{P_y}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_2+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2\right)}\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_2+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_m\cos\theta_m\right)}\\
&=\frac{P_y}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_1+n_2\cos\theta_2\right)}=L^{+}_{1/2,y}P_y
\end{aligned}
$$

**p偏振：来自 $P_x$ 的贡献。**

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{+}_{\mathrm{SF},p}(\text{来自 }P_x)&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,x}P_x\frac{r_{m1,p}}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}+L^+_{m/m,x}P_x\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}\Bigr]t_{m2,p}\\
&=\frac{\cos\theta_m}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}P_x\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_1}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}\\
&=\frac{\cos\theta_1}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_x=L^{+}_{1/2,x}P_x
\end{aligned}
$$

**p偏振：来自 $P_z$ 的贡献。** 公式跨独立PDF p19—20：

$$
\begin{aligned}
E^{+}_{\mathrm{SF},p}(\text{来自 }P_z)&=\Bigl[L^-_{m/m,z}P_z\frac{r_{m1,p}}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}+L^+_{m/m,z}P_z\frac{1}{1-r_{m1,p}r_{m2,p}}\Bigr]t_{m2,p}\\
&=\frac{-\sin\theta_m}{2n_m\cos\theta_m}P_z\frac{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}{2n_m\cos\theta_m\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}\frac{2n_1\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_1\right)}\\
&\quad\times\frac{2n_m\cos\theta_m}{\left(n_2\cos\theta_m+n_m\cos\theta_2\right)}\\
&=\frac{-(n_1/n_m)\sin\theta_m}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_z=\frac{-(n_1/n_m)^2\sin\theta_1}{\left(n_1\cos\theta_2+n_2\cos\theta_1\right)}P_z=L^{+}_{1/2,z}P_z
\end{aligned}
$$

证毕。
